IGUI_AVC_Title: The Good Gear (TGG): Armor vs Comfort
IGUI_AVC_GearLine: With your current clothes, your discomfort will climb up to %1.
IGUI_AVC_Desensitized: Desensitized: your gear causes no discomfort.
IGUI_AVC_Help1: Every worn item (clothes, armor, bags) has a discomfort value, in points. Their sum is where your discomfort is heading: the red marker on the bar.
IGUI_AVC_Help2: Discomfort climbs slowly up to that marker, and drops quickly when you take things off.
IGUI_AVC_Help3: Being wet, cold or hot, sleeping on a bad bed or on the floor, dragging a corpse or driving an overloaded vehicle add more. Alcohol lowers it, by half at most.
IGUI_AVC_Help4: From 20, the Uncomfortable moodle appears and stress starts to rise. It gets worse at 40, 60 and 80.
IGUI_AVC_Help5: Protection is your average bite and scratch protection over the 17 body parts. Bite and Scratch columns: each item's own protection. Look for the gear that protects the most for the fewest points.
IGUI_AVC_OptKeyTip: You can also right-click a clothing item or a bag.
IGUI_AVC_OptRefreshTip: How often the open window recalculates, 1 second minimum. A low value recalculates more often and can slow down a modest PC: raise it if the game stutters. Nothing is calculated while the window is closed.
IGUI_AVC_OptShowFreeTip: Also list the worn items that cause no discomfort, with their protection.
IGUI_AVC_OptHelpTip: A ? next to your gear explains the formula when you hover it.
IGUI_AVC_Tagline: Fight to live. Dress to fight.
IGUI_AVC_OptSizeTip: Size of the texts, numbers and bars.
IGUI_AVC_OptMaxHTip: Beyond this, the list of worn items scrolls with the mouse wheel.
IGUI_AVC_OptGameNamesTip: A renamed item (a bag you named, for example) is listed under its real name.
IGUI_AVC_MiniGear: Your gear takes your discomfort up to %1.
IGUI_AVC_OptRefreshWarn: Note: the shorter the update interval, the more often the window recalculates, which can affect the game's performance. Set it with care, and raise it if the game stutters.
IGUI_AVC_EnvLine: Your current surroundings and situation cause you %1 discomfort.
IGUI_AVC_NoEnv: Nothing around you adds discomfort right now.
IGUI_AVC_OptShowEnvTip: Red marker on the bar and the environmental discomfort section (wet, cold, heat, bed, corpse, vehicle, alcohol).
IGUI_AVC_OptGreenTip: Bite and scratch values of each item in green, darker for more protection.
IGUI_AVC_HolesTip: This item has holes on %1 body part(s): its protection is lower there. Patch the holes to restore it.
IGUI_AVC_HolesTipNoRepair: This item has holes on %1 body part(s): its protection is lower there. This item can't be repaired.
IGUI_AVC_NowRise: It will progressively rise to a maximum of %1.
